paragraphs: Info Page
Owners are legally required to register, secure and maintain vacant property.

sections.heading: Definition
paragraphs: A vacant or abandoned building is defined as being unoccupied with any of the following:
No current lease or rental agreement
No security
Boarding up for security
Multiple code violations
Unoccupied for more than 30 days
A building can also be considered vacant or abandoned if it is partially occupied but has been cited for blight .

sections.heading: Annual requirements
paragraphs: Every year, you are legally required to document the following.

sections.heading: Annual requirements › Secure your vacant property
paragraphs: The property must be secured so that only people you authorize are able to access it.

sections.heading: Annual requirements › Maintain your vacant building
paragraphs: Inside the property:
Prevent damage from rain and plumbing leaks
Regularly clear garbage and other debris
Make sure the property does not have pests like mice or insects
Shut off utilities that are not needed for building maintenance
Outside the property:
Maintain landscaping and other plants
Regularly clear trash and debris. Clean up graffiti

Make sure parts of your building are safe and in good condition, including: Paint and finishes Foundation Roof Chimneys and flues Gutters, downspouts, scuppers, and flashing Windows and skylights Exterior stairs and decks

sections.heading: Annual requirements › Post a sign for the public
paragraphs: The sign must be at least 8.5 by 11 inches, and be visible by the public. It should also be protected from the weather. See a sample sign .
Include the name, address, and phone number of the owner of record (or authorized agent).
If there is a notice of default or foreclosure recorded for the property, also include the lender’s name, address, and phone number.

sections.heading: Annual requirements › Register and pay fees for your vacant building every year
paragraphs: Every year, we will send a letter reminding you to:
Register your vacant building
Register your vacant storefront
Once the property is no longer vacant, remove your building from the vacant or abandoned building list .
